episodes.title: Don't Call Me Nelly
episodes.summary: England, 1705: Nell Jackson's supernatural fighting skills stir up trouble on her return from war.

episodes.title: Tracks Less Well Trod
episodes.summary: On the run from the law, Nell, Roxy and George turn to highway robbery to survive.

episodes.title: A Private Joke With the Queen
episodes.summary: Poynton's dark magic catches up with Nell. One of her sisters is dangerously wounded in the escape.

episodes.title: Devil's Dung
episodes.summary: Nell risks capture to find a doctor, and the gang receive help from some unlikely sources.

episodes.title: Excuse Me, I'm a Doctor
episodes.summary: Nell goes to Newgate Prison to try and rescue Devereux, and Roxy and George meet their Uncle Jack.

episodes.title: Snatched by Strollers
episodes.summary: Nell sets out to rescue George, and Rasselas finally confronts Sofia.

episodes.title: Stop Printing This Muck
episodes.summary: The gang head to Fleet Street to stop the news sheets from printing lies about Nell.

episodes.title: Not Some Cheap Trick
episodes.summary: Nell and the gang race against time to stop Poynton and save the Queen.
